text: ImplAuditCS2 F1/F2: a generic fn's bare Dict bound to its declared T reads Dict(T) in the signature, so put<T>(d: Dict, v: T) can no longer write a str into an i64 dict (E0102); a method call on an untyped lambda param that resolves to the enclosing fn's type param is looked up in that param's bounds (E0403). Both programs checked clean and panicked at run time before.
